lines.japanese: 「やべえ、成田と女が消えた！」
lines.english: “Shit! Narita and the girl disappeared!”

lines.japanese: 「その辺の店に入ったんでしょ、はーい分散して探すよお！」
lines.english: “They probably ducked into one of these places. All right, spread out and search!”

lines.japanese: しかしあいつら、相変わらず芝居がかってるというか、無駄に統制が取れているというか……。
lines.english: They really were as theatrical as ever. Or pointlessly well coordinated...

lines.japanese: 厄介な追っ手の目から逃れて、俺と鳴は身じろぎせずに息をひそめていた。思った通り、俺を探しているのはもはや大司教ひとりじゃなかったようだ。
lines.english: Hidden from our troublesome pursuers' eyes, Naru and I held our breath without moving a muscle. Just as I had suspected, the Archbishop was no longer hunting me alone.

lines.japanese: 俺たちはパルクレープからヘテロへ向かう道のりの半分を越えたあたりで、運悪くＲ－ウィングの小隊に出くわしてしまった。
lines.english: A little over halfway from Paru Crêpes to Hetero, we had the bad luck to run into an R-Wing patrol.

lines.japanese: 深く俯き小走りでやり過ごそうとする女連れの俺に気付いて、やつらは声を掛けあいながら追ってきた。
lines.english: They spotted me trying to hurry past with my head down and a girl beside me, called out to one another, and gave chase.

lines.japanese: 俺たちは角をひとつ曲がってやつらの視界から消えた隙に、走って三軒目のビルの１階エレベーターホールに飛びこんだ。
lines.english: We rounded one corner and vanished from their sight, then sprinted into the ground-floor elevator lobby of the third building along.

lines.japanese: そうしていま、通りからは死角となっている階段の陰に、ふたり縮こまって身を隠している。エレベーターの横で華々しく灯っているソープやイメクラのパネル看板が、ひどく場違いに思えた。
lines.english: Now we crouched together beneath the stairs, in a blind spot from the street, holding perfectly still. Beside the elevator, brilliantly lit panels advertising brothels and role-play sex clubs looked grotesquely out of place.

lines.japanese: 「しっ！」
lines.english: “Shh!”

lines.japanese: 「うぷっ」
lines.english: “Mmph.”

lines.japanese: 鳴の口を塞いだまま、さらに数十秒待つ。
lines.english: Still covering Naru's mouth, I waited another few dozen seconds.

lines.japanese: やがて、街の喧騒からひときわ抜きんでた、やつらのけたたましい怒声は聞こえなくなった。
lines.english: At last, their shrill bellows, cutting above even the city's clamor, faded away.

lines.japanese: 「……行ったか」
lines.english: “...Are they gone?”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴を放して、首を物陰の外へ伸ばした。
lines.english: I let go of Naru and craned my neck out from behind our cover.

lines.japanese: 「彼女はのちに青春時代を振りかえってこう語るだろう。初めてのクチビルは、汗と泥まみれのてのひらに奪われましたｉｎ風俗ビル」
lines.english: “Years later, she would look back upon her youth and say: ‘My first kiss was stolen by a filthy, sweaty palm—in a sex-club building.’”

lines.japanese: 聞こえよがしな鳴の独り言を無視して、俺は身を乗りだしながら慎重に様子をうかがう。ひとまず追跡者たちの姿はないように見えた。
lines.english: I ignored Naru’s pointed monologue and leaned out to survey the street. For the moment, our pursuers were nowhere in sight.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、鬼ごっこですか」
lines.english: “Um, are we playing tag?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、そんなとこ」
lines.english: “Something like that.”

lines.japanese: 俺は一瞬考えてからそう答えた。
lines.english: I thought for a moment before answering.

lines.japanese: 「えーと……いまの方々、Ｒなんとかの皆さんですよね」
lines.english: “Um... Those people just now were from R-Something, weren't they?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、まー、そうだな」
lines.english: “Yeah. Something like that.”

lines.japanese: 「自転車探しの方は、もう飽きてしまわれたんでしょうか」
lines.english: “Have they perhaps grown tired of searching for the bicycle?”

lines.japanese: 「さあ。俺にはもう何がなんだかさっぱり──あ、やべ」
lines.english: “Who knows? I don't have a clue what's happening anymore—oh, shit.”

lines.japanese: 言いかけてすぐに体を引いた。はす向かいの飲食店ビルから、例のモッズファッションに身をくるんだ男が下りてきたからだ。
lines.english: I pulled back mid-sentence. The man in that familiar mod getup had just come out of the restaurant building diagonally across the street.

lines.japanese: 「んー？　なんですかー？」
lines.english: “Hmm? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ待て」
lines.english: “Just wait.”

lines.japanese: 首を伸ばしかけた鳴を、掴んで引きもどす。
lines.english: Naru started to crane her neck out, so I caught her and pulled her back.

lines.japanese: 小娘を押さえたまま、俺は体のほとんどを壁に隠しながら目だけでモッズ男を追った。たしかミチヤとか言ったか、そいつはひょいひょい舞うような足取りで、すぐ隣りのファーストフードショップへ入っていった。
lines.english: Keeping Naru still, I hid almost all of myself behind the wall and followed the mod with my eyes. Michiya, if I remembered right. He went skipping into the fast-food place next door as though he were dancing.

lines.japanese: ということは、逆に考えれば、いまあいつが出てきた方の飲食店ビルは捜索済みということだ。
lines.english: Which meant they had already searched the restaurant building he had just left.

lines.japanese: ということは、当面あのビルにはＲ－ウィングが入ってこない。
lines.english: Which meant R-Wing wouldn't enter it again for a while.

lines.japanese: ということは、俺たちにとって安全な場所。
lines.english: Which meant it was safe for us.

lines.japanese: 「よし……行くぞ、付いてこい」
lines.english: “All right... Let's go. Stay with me.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、何階ですか」
lines.english: “Oh. Which floor?”

lines.japanese: 鳴はエレベーター横のいかがわしいパネル群をもの欲しそうに眺めていた。
lines.english: Naru gazed with hungry interest at the disreputable panels beside the elevator.

lines.japanese: 「上じゃねえよ」
lines.english: “We're not going upstairs.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの腕を引いて風俗ビルの外へ飛びだした。そのまま向かいの飲食店ビルめがけ、大型自動車一台分の狭い幅を早足で横断する。
lines.english: I pulled her by the arm and burst out of the sex-club building. Then we hurried across the narrow road—barely one large vehicle wide—toward the restaurant building opposite.

lines.japanese: 「おう、ここに隠れるぞ」
lines.english: “Here. We'll hide in this place.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、あーはい」
lines.english: “Oh. All right.”

lines.japanese: 自動ドアをするりと抜けて、全国チェーンの大衆居酒屋に踊りこんだ。木目の調度で設えた温かみのある店内は、アルコールのにおいと大人たちの笑い声で満ちていた。
lines.english: We slipped through the automatic doors into a popular national chain of casual pubs. The warm wood interior was full of the smell of alcohol and grown-ups laughing.

lines.japanese: 「いらっしゃいませェ！」
lines.english: “Welcome!”

lines.japanese: 社員らしき年輩の店員が、すぐに演技過剰な笑顔で寄ってくる。
lines.english: An older staffer, probably a full-time employee, came over at once with an exaggerated smile.

lines.japanese: 「お客様、本日は二名様の──」
lines.english: “A table for two this evening—”

lines.japanese: しかし店員は、俺の後ろに立っていた連れの姿に改めて気付くと、たちまち営業スマイルに困惑の色を付けたした。
lines.english: But when he noticed the person standing behind me, confusion crept into his practiced smile.

lines.japanese: 「あー、すいませんねェ。当店は制服でのご来店はちょっと……」
lines.english: “Ah, I'm sorry. We can't admit customers in school uniform...”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ご来店じゃないっす。すぐ出てくから便所だけ貸して」
lines.english: “We're not here as customers. We'll be right out, so just let us use the restroom.”
“...Excuse me?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、いや、困りますよ。お客さんじゃないなら尚更そんな……」
lines.english: “What? No, that would be a problem. If you aren't customers, then all the more—”

lines.japanese: 「いいじゃん便所ぐらい。すっげ、も、ちびりそうなんすよマジで」
lines.english: “Come on, it's just the restroom. She's seriously about to wet herself.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、おまえ便所行ってこい」
lines.english: “Go on. Use the restroom.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょっと！　だから困りますって！」
lines.english: “Hey, wait! I told you, that's a problem!”

lines.japanese: 「頼むよ、すぐ済むから。ほんとすぐ。こいつ、早出しナルの異名まで持ってるから」
lines.english: “Please, it'll be quick. Really quick. They don't call her Quick-Draw Naru for nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うそですよー？」
lines.english: “Th-that isn't true, you know?”

lines.japanese: 「嘘だって言ってるじゃない」
lines.english: “She says it isn't true.”

lines.japanese: 「嘘じゃねえよ、マジ早えーんだって。鬼っ早なんだって。それはもう、鉄砲魚とて目を疑うぐらい早えーんだって」
lines.english: “It's true. She's insanely fast. Demon fast. So fast even an archerfish would doubt its eyes.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ全然ですよー。それはもう、鍾乳石のきざはしを流れる清水のように緩やかですよー」
lines.english: “Not in the least. Mine flows as gently as clear spring water trickling down the steps of a limestone cavern.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから。おまえ、そんな冗談とかいいから。とにかくアレ、ちょっと便所でお花とか摘んでろ。な。俺ひとっ走りして、缶蹴っとばしてくるから」
lines.english: “Enough. Forget the jokes. Just go pick flowers in the restroom for a while, okay? I'm going for a quick run to kick the can.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、あの、鬼ごっこじゃなかったんですか」
lines.english: “Oh. Weren't we playing tag?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、まー、厳密に言うと缶ケリだったんだよ。な。この缶ケリ、捕まると罰ゲームすげえから、マジで。ちゃんと隠れてろよおまえ。そのあいだ好きなだけじゃーじゃー出していいから」
lines.english: “Well, technically it was kick the can. Listen, the penalty if you get caught is brutal. I mean it, so hide properly. You can run the water as much as you like while you wait.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、私、膀胱からっぽなのにー」
lines.english: “But my bladder is empty.”

lines.japanese: 口を尖らせてぶつぶつ抗議する鳴の背中を、俺はむりやり押しだして女子便所へ向かわせた。
lines.english: Naru pursed her lips and muttered protests while I forcibly pushed her toward the women's restroom.

lines.japanese: 俺が鷲介みたいに両手を合わせてへこへこ頭を下げると、中年の店員は不承不承ながら納得してくれた。
lines.english: I pressed my palms together and bobbed my head like Shusuke. The middle-aged employee reluctantly gave in.
“Phew...”

lines.japanese: 俺は口から息を吹きあげて前髪を揺らすと（誰かの真似）、居酒屋を出て素早く隣りのファーストフードへ向かった。
lines.english: I blew upward to toss my bangs—imitating someone—then left the pub and hurried to the fast-food place next door.

lines.japanese: しかし中には入らない。入口の脇、ガラス張りの建物の影で、店内の様子を伺いながら何気ない素振りで待つ。
lines.english: I didn't go inside. Beside the entrance, in the shadow of the glass-fronted building, I waited with studied nonchalance while watching the interior.

lines.japanese: 少しすると、上の階の客席から背の高い男が急ぎ足で階段を下りてくるのが見えた。やつだ。さっきのミチヤとかいうモッズ野郎だ。
lines.english: Before long, a tall man hurried down the stairs from the upstairs seating area. Him. The mod bastard named Michiya or something.

lines.japanese: そいつが自動ドアをすり抜け、何も知らずに小走りで俺の目の前を通りすぎてゆく──ところへ、俺は音を殺して飛びだし、すれ違う寸前で振りの小さな一発をヒュッと埋めこんだ。
lines.english: He slipped through the automatic doors and jogged past me, none the wiser. Just before we crossed paths, I darted out without a sound and landed one short, sharp punch.

lines.japanese: やつは一瞬、なにが起こったかさえ理解できなかっただろう。突如として内臓の奥深くまで突きささった衝撃に、男は目を剥き、震える両手を添えて体を折った。
lines.english: For an instant, he probably did not even know what had happened. The shock drove deep into his gut; his eyes bulged and he doubled over, pressing trembling hands to his stomach.

lines.japanese: 「甘ェよ」
lines.english: “Too easy.”

lines.japanese: そう簡単に休ませるかよ。俺は容赦なくその手を引っぺがし、同じ場所へもう一発を打ちこんだ。マルチネスの分。
lines.english: Like hell I'd let him rest so soon. I tore his hands away without mercy and drove another blow into the same place. One for Martinez.

lines.japanese: 「おいおいヤマダぁ、だからオメー、飲みすぎんなって言ったろォ」
lines.english: “Come on, Yamada. I told you not to drink so damn much.”

lines.japanese: 雑踏の目をやり過ごすため、俺は友人の振りをして名字も知らないその男の背中に触れた。自ら屈みこんで、その脇に肩を入れた。やつは汚い胃液を垂らしながら、ひゅうひゅう喘ぐようにうめいた。
lines.english: To fool the passing crowd, I played the friend and laid a hand on the back of a man whose surname I didn't know. I bent down and wedged my shoulder under his arm. He wheezed and groaned, dirty bile dribbling from his mouth.

lines.japanese: 「お……まえ……なり、たァ……」
lines.english: “Y-you... Nari... ta...”

lines.japanese: 「なに？　ああ？　ったく、しょーがねえなあヤマダは。よえーくせに粋がって無理するからだ。おうホラ、こんなとこでヘバッてたら迷惑だろ、早くこっち来いって」
lines.english: “What? Huh? Honestly, Yamada, you're hopeless. You act tough and overdo it when you can't hold your liquor. Come on. You're blocking everyone doubled over here. Let's get you out of the way.”

lines.japanese: 俺は気の抜けた三文芝居を続けながら、仮名・山田の体をさっきの風俗ビルまで引きずっていった。
lines.english: Keeping up the limp, third-rate performance, I dragged the provisionally christened Yamada back to the sex-club building.

lines.japanese: エレベーターホールまで連れこむと、通りから陰になっているあの階段の上へ叩きつけるように放りすてる。
lines.english: Once inside the elevator lobby, I flung him onto the stairs hidden from the street hard enough to slam him down.

lines.japanese: 青いカラコンが嫌味な山田の横っつらを、左右一発ずつはたいてから──
lines.english: I slapped Yamada’s smug face once on each side. Those blue contacts only made him look more insufferable.

lines.japanese: 「おい雑魚。女はどこだ」
lines.english: “All right, small fry. Where's the woman?”

lines.japanese: ──感情を殺した声で質した。
lines.english: I asked in a voice empty of emotion.
“W-woman...?”

lines.japanese: 俺に組みしかれ見下ろされ、山田は紫がかった不健康そうな唇をかすかに震わせていた。
lines.english: I held him down and looked into his face. His sickly violet lips trembled.

lines.japanese: 「とぼけんな。てめーらが攫った女だ、よ」
lines.english: “Don't play dumb. The woman you bastards kidnapped.”

lines.japanese: 「ぎああああっ……！！」
lines.english: “Gyaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 弱ってる山田の腹に足を落とし、容赦なく体重をかけた。メンマの分。やつは女受けしそうなイケツラを醜く歪めて悶絶した。
lines.english: I dropped my foot onto the weakened Yamada's stomach and leaned my weight into it without mercy. One for Menma. His handsome face—the kind women would go for—twisted into ugly agony.

lines.japanese: いまや俺の思考には、あの白い靄がかからなかった。首の後ろから鈍い痛みが昇ってこなかった。声なき意思の接近を感じなかった。だからなんだって話。
lines.english: No white haze clouded my mind now. No dull ache climbed from the back of my neck. I felt no voiceless will drawing near. So what?

lines.japanese: 「おう、もっかい聞くぞ。女ァどこだ、ああ」
lines.english: “I'll ask you again. Where's the woman?”

lines.japanese: 俺はふたたび足に力を入れた。亜衣の分。
lines.english: I pressed down with my foot again. One for Ai.

lines.japanese: 「あああああああっ！！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaaagh!”

lines.japanese: 「しら、しら、知らない！　知らないよ！　かはっ……なんだ女って……げほ、ウッ」
lines.english: “I-I-I don't know! I don't know! Khah... What woman...? Ugh—cough!”

lines.japanese: 「ウッじゃねえよ、ペレス・プラードかてめえは。ふざけてねえで言え、このアナル野郎」
lines.english: “Quit the ‘ugh.’ What are you, Pérez Prado? Cut the mambo act and talk, you anal freak.”

lines.japanese: 「ほ、本当だよ、知らないって！　本当にそんな話は聞いてないんだ！　うちの班の担当はラーメン屋のおっさんだけで、そんな、女なんか本当に知らないんだって！」
lines.english: “I swear I don't know! I really haven't heard anything about that! My group was only assigned the old guy with the ramen stall. I honestly don't know anything about a woman!”

lines.japanese: 「……クソが」
lines.english: “...Goddamn it.”

lines.japanese: 雑兵じゃ話にならないのか。
lines.english: A foot soldier would not know enough.

lines.japanese: 俺は踏み心地の悪い黒布団から足を下ろすと、やつのスラックスの脇を外から叩いて硬い感触を探した。あった。ポケットに手を入れ、その真っ黒い携帯電話を引きずりだす。
lines.english: I took my foot off the unpleasant black mattress, then patted the outside of his slacks until I found something hard. There. I reached into his pocket and pulled out a pitch-black phone.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ大司教ってやつに伝えろ。『俺をやりてえなら俺をやれ。せこい真似ばっかしてんじゃねえ』」
lines.english: “Then give the Archbishop a message: ‘If you want me dead, come after me. Quit pulling this cowardly shit.’”

lines.japanese: ケータイをこじ開けて山田の胸元へ落とす。それからやつの襟首を掴み、乱暴に頭を引きおこした。
lines.english: I pried the phone open and dropped it onto Yamada's chest. Then I seized him by the collar and hauled his head roughly upright.

lines.japanese: 「『いまからお望み通りてめえらの聖地に出向いてやんよ。おとなしく待っとけやコラ！　これ以上早まった真似したらてめえ、ブッ殺すぞこの野郎、アアッ！』」
lines.english: “‘I'm coming to your precious holy ground now, just like you wanted. Sit tight and wait, asshole! Try anything rash before I get there, and I'll fucking kill you! You hear me?’”

lines.japanese: 「わ、分かった、分かった伝えるよ、伝えるから許し……ぶぺえっ！」
lines.english: “I-I understand! I'll tell him, I'll tell him, so please forgi—bweh!”

lines.japanese: 最後に、青ざめて竦みあがった醜い顔面を三発殴った。プラチナの分。
lines.english: Finally, I punched his pale, cringing face three times. For Platinum.

lines.japanese: もちろん、そんなことをしたって気分が晴れるわけではなかった。
lines.english: Of course, none of it made me feel any better.
